messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU pool pressure detected (queue_depth: 1389, pods_pending: 67, 95th_token_latency: 2.6s). Escalating to on-call. Trigger time: 2026-03-15T07:12:00Z

pagerduty: @sam_oncall, P0. Please acknowledge.

sam_oncall: ack. I'm awake. Starting triage — what's the immediate symptom?

nina_platform: seeing lots of Pending pods for job-runner-gpu. HPA not scaling as expected. prometheus-adapter metrics show 10+ minute scrape lag; metrics-server looks healthy. Prometheus query latencies > 3m.

oz_runtime: Confirmed. Prometheus ingestion backlog spiked after a deploy that enabled per-model label enrichment. TSDB wal size is high. prometheus-adapter returns 504s for custom metrics queries. HPA target metric is custom.googleapis.com/gpu_queue_len (custom metric) and it's stale.

cap_ops: Cloud reports autoscaler requests returning 429/403 for quota. Our GPU quota in region-us-east1 is at 100% allocation — can't get more nodes until quota increase.

rachel_custeng: Customer impact: two customers on dedicated pools reporting 504s for long-running generation. One enterprise (omega-finance) has lodged support ticket and is awaiting update.

sam_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop non-critical batch jobs to free queue 2) route enterprise customers to CPU fallback if model variant available 3) attempt quick prometheus-adapter failover to alternate instance 4) check for emergency quota bump or multi-region spot pool.

nina_platform: I'm going to cordon autoscale-heavy nodes and drain any long-running dev jobs. Also will scale adapter-canary in us-east-1 up to 3 replicas and scale primary down. Running commands now:
```
kubectl -n monitoring scale deployment/prometheus-adapter-canary --replicas=3
kubectl -n monitoring scale deployment/prometheus-adapter --replicas=0
kubectl -n jobs scale deployment/batch-job-runner --replicas=0
```

oz_runtime: I'm toggling the model-metrics enrich feature off to reduce cardinality. Patching config map and rolling restart.

sam_oncall: Cap, can you request quota increase? If slow, approve starting a temporary spot-backed pool in us-west-2.

cap_ops: Submitted quota ticket (#Q-9921) with cloud support for GPUs. Estimated 25-40m. I can spin up spot pool in us-west-2 (8 GPUs) within ~12m. Need approval to allow cross-region scheduling.

rachel_custeng: Please route omega-finance to CPU fallback and tell me when done so I can let them know.

sam_oncall: @rachel_custeng routing policy applied: header X-Cust-ID:omega-finance -> model-cpu-fallback-v1, concurrency_limit=2. Also throttled batch ingestion via rate-limit rule.

nina_platform: adapter-canary started accepting queries but still high latency — looks like Prometheus itself is overloaded. Rolling back the per-model label change removed ~40% of series and Prometheus CPU downscaling shows improvement.

oz_runtime: Prometheus query latencies dropping 3m -> 40s. Adapter back to returning metrics. HPA sees metrics again, but many scale-up events were queued and scheduler can't bind pods because of node quota.

cap_ops: spot pool in us-west-2 created and registered. We've applied a node affinity rule so new pods can land there. Pending count dropped by ~28 pods.

rachel_custeng: omega-finance retried and reports successful connections, errors reduced to baseline. Sending update to the customer.

sam_oncall: status update: queue_depth down from 1389 -> 220. 95th latency down to ~650ms. Remaining Pending pods ~12. Cloud quota still pending but relief from spot pool.

nina_platform: follow-up actions to include: limit per-model labels, add rate-limiter on TSDB ingestion, alert for adapter-query-latency > 1m, and HPA fallback when custom metrics stale for > 90s.

oz_runtime: also add HPA circuit-breaker so it won't attempt repeated scale-ups when node quota rejected. Add safe-mode to use kube metrics after X failures.

cap_ops: cloud quota approved with emergency bump (confirmed). We'll keep spot pool as auto-fallback if primary quota is saturated. Creating ticket to automate spot fallback.

sam_oncall: marking incident as mitigated. Please keep thread open for postmortem and timeline. Assigning owners: metrics: @nina_platform, autoscale: @cap_ops, runtime: @oz_runtime, customer comms: @rachel_custeng.

incident-bot: Incident P0 -> P1. Please file postmortem within 72h.

rachel_custeng: I'll follow up with omega-finance and the other impacted customers with a summary.

nina_platform: final commands logged:
```
# rollback label enrichment
kubectl -n models rollout undo deployment/model-metrics-enricher
# restart adapter canary
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter-canary
# pause non-critical batch jobs
kubectl -n jobs scale deployment/batch-job-runner --replicas=0
# create spot pool
terraform apply -var='region=us-west-2' -target=module.gpu_spot_pool
```

sam_oncall: Great work everyone. Closing alert in 15m if stable. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident 23803 resolved. Postmortem required.

sam_oncall: I'll draft the timeline and recommendations and link postmortem doc here when ready. Thanks all.
